dedupe_keys.name: geotechnical site characterization at the drainage farm site

description: Geotechnical site characterization at the Drainage Farm Site is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Aser Abbas, Utah State University (usu.edu). A surface wave field-testing campaign was conducted at the Drainage Farm Site in Logan, Utah, USA, a property owned by Utah State University (USU). The field testing involved both active-source multichannel analysis of surface waves (MASW) testing and ambient noise (microtremor array measurements: MAM) testing. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-sx2h-8s20. Keywords: MASW; MAM; ambient noise; active source; surface wave; in-situ testing; site characterization; geotechnical; geophysical; Rayleigh wave; phase velocity; attenuation; damping. Published 2024-04-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
